case.note: depth is the vendor's figure, not measured: M5Stack's specification table gives 54.0 x 54.0 x 15.5 mm, its dimension drawing (the CoreS3-Lite's, which the CoreS3-SE page links as its model size) 15.5 mm for the frame and 16.5 mm over the back cover, and its CoreS3-SE.stl a 15.5 mm frame with the cover 1.0 mm proud of it; the model's case is that frame, 15.5 mm. It was 15.0 until 2026-11-17, the owner's hand measurement of 2026-07-15, taken without a caliper, as was his 22.0 mm with the battery base module attached (the vendor's files stack to 23.5 mm: the frame and the M5GO Battery Bottom3's 8.0 mm body). R5 shell; light grey frame around one black glass front set 1.47 mm inside the outline (R3.53). color is the front's case color at the top.

display.note: Active area datasheet-verified 2026-07-15: 40.80 x 30.60 mm (2.0", ~199 PPI, pixel pitch 0.1275 mm square); was 48.0 x 36.0 mm (~169 PPI). Origin from M5Stack's dimension drawing of the CoreS3 Lite shell (same case, 2026-10-19): the active area centered in the glass print's window 6.2-47.8 x 11.3-42.7 mm (41.6 x 31.4); the front render's lit rectangle lands within 0.2 mm of it.

notes: Full-glass front panel; capacitive touch is the primary input. Under the window the glass carries the red touch print "< < ○ > >" (ring 2.58 mm across at 27.0, 46.40 mm) and a microphone hole 13.93 mm either side of it (DUAL MIC), from M5Stack's renders and the CoreS3 Lite drawing (2026-10-19); the SE has no camera and no proximity/light sensor. Power (left edge) and Reset (bottom edge) positions owner-measured 2026-07-15; neither is visible from the front. The whole glass is the pointer (TouchScreen, logical "pointer"), and TouchA/B/C are the three bottom-bar zones under it, which carry the fleet's three logical buttons. They are not printed marks: the FT6336U reaches 40 rows below the 240-row display (raw Y up to 278, owner-measured; TOUCH_ZONE_STRIP_BELOW_DISPLAY in the Kleidos firmware's variants/cores3_se/variant.h) and a contact there routes to one of three equal columns of the panel's width (zoneForSample, src/hal/common/m5_touch_button_input.cpp), so each zone is 40.8/3 mm wide by 30.6 x 40/240 mm tall, directly under the active area. The red print is decoration and does not line up with them: its ring marks TouchB, but its two inner chevrons sit across the A/B and B/C boundaries. The same derivation on the Core2 v1.3 lands within 0.25 mm of that board's three printed rings, which is the cross-check.
